repos.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
repos.hook: Meta built Astryx as an open-source design system. A design system is a set of reusable visual components for user interfaces. Astryx works directly with AI agents. Agents can read the component rules and build web layouts automatically.
repos.personalization: As a fullstack engineer using AI coding tools, you can test how accurately agents assemble frontend interfaces with these standardized components.

repos.hook: Anthropic shares ready-made capabilities for AI agents in this repository. Agents use these skills to run code, search files, and complete computer tasks. You can add these skills directly into your automated workflows.
repos.personalization: This repository provides concrete prompt patterns and tool definitions that you can inspect and benchmark in your applied prompt evaluation work.

repos.description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks
repos.hook: Sherlock is an open-source tool that searches for user accounts across the web. You give it one username. It checks hundreds of social media platforms to find matching profiles.

repos.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
repos.hook: Plannotator gives developers a visual workspace to review AI agent work. AI agents write code and suggest plans inside the app. You can annotate their plans and send feedback in one click. An annotation is a written note or correction on text.
repos.personalization: It fits your workflow if you need a practical human-in-the-loop interface to inspect, evaluate, and steer AI coding agents.

repos.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
repos.hook: This tool lets AI agents control a web browser from the command line. The agent can open web pages, click buttons, and extract text. It uses Rust for fast execution.
repos.personalization: You can use this to build automated testing pipelines where AI agents verify your web applications end-to-end.

repos.description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。 LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.
repos.hook: This tool uses large language models to analyze stock markets every day. It collects market prices and financial news articles. Then, it creates a summary report and sends notifications to your chat apps.
repos.personalization: You could adapt its analysis prompts and data pipelines to screen Malaysian equities against Shariah-compliant financial criteria.

repos.description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
repos.hook: Sure is an open-source personal finance application. It helps people track bank balances, record expenses, and organize budgets. Anyone can inspect or modify the code.
repos.personalization: This codebase offers a clean base if you want to build an ethical personal finance tool with custom Zakat calculations.

repos.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
repos.hook: OpenMausBot is an open-source automation bot. It connects an AI agent to a virtual machine. A virtual machine is an isolated software computer running inside your system. The AI can run programs safely inside this sandbox. A sandbox is a secure space where code cannot harm the host computer.

repos.description: Open-source plugin for designing and reviewing software with agents
repos.hook: This project helps teams design and review software architecture with AI agents. Software architecture means the overall structure and organization of a software system. The agents inspect software designs before developers write code.
repos.personalization: It offers an interesting multi-agent prompt structure that you can evaluate for automated software design reviews.

repos.description: Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
repos.hook: MuJoCo is a physics engine for robotics and biomechanics research. A physics engine simulates real-world physical forces like gravity and friction. It calculates how objects move and collide in three dimensions.

repos.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
repos.hook: This repository contains practical instructions and scripts for AI coding assistants. These skills teach agents how to write cleaner code, run tests, and refactor files. Refactoring means improving code structure without changing how the software behaves.
repos.personalization: This is a direct source of production-ready prompts that you can test, evaluate, and adapt for your own AI coding stack.
